title: Heart of the Storm: Lightning
html:
Heart of the Storm: Lightning is a Storm Sorcery Sorcerer free reaction, part of Heart of the Storm, that creates a storm that deals half your Sorcerer level, rounded down, when you cast a lightning spell.

Description

When you cast a spell that deals ⁠Lightning damage, you cause a small, local storm. All enemies within 6 m (20 ft) take (Sorcerer level / 2)⁠⁠Lightning damage.

Properties

Damage
Sorcerer level / 2⁠Lightning
Details
 Range: Self
 AoE: 6 m (20 ft) Radius
 Targets: All enemies in the radius

Technical details

UIDs
Projectile_HeartOfTheStorm_Lightning
Action which creates the explosion
Interrupt_HeartOfTheStorm_Lightning
Reaction which triggers the ability
Spell flags
IsHarmful

How to learn

This spell is a variation of:
Heart of the Storm

Notes

  • The following spells can trigger this reaction:
    •  Call Lightning /  Activate Call Lightning
    •  Chain Lightning
    •  Chromatic Orb: Lightning
    •  Glyph of Warding: Lightning
    •  Lightning Arrow
    •  Lightning Bolt
    •  Shocking Grasp including through  War Caster: Opportunity Spell
    •  Witch Bolt /  Activate Witch Bolt
  • Additionally, the following non-damaging spells can also trigger this reaction:
    •  Bolts of Doom
    •  Conjure Elemental: Air Elemental
    •  Conjure Elemental: Air Myrmidon
    •  Planar Ally: Djinni
  • Any other spell will not trigger this reaction, including spells which deal ⁠Lightning damage through effects like  Lightning Charges.
